executiveSummary: Analysis covers 100 Advanced Core matches under Engine v4.2.6 / Rules v4.2.0. All matches completed without aborts. Highest win rate: control-conversion-tactical at 100.0% (CI [0.610, 1.000], 6 games). No synergy pairs reached statistical significance after FDR correction. 173 mechanic(s) measured with evidence-backed associations. 22 anomaly/anomalies flagged (0 critical, 5 warning, 17 info). Data completeness: PASS (no unclassified facts). Mechanics and synergy outputs are policy-, seat-, profile-, and telemetry-conditioned. They are evidence-backed associations, not automatic canon or balance changes. Win association is not causal proof. Synergy interaction is the A×B odds-ratio from a stratified logistic model.

win-rate.denominator: decisive cross-policy games (draws, aborts and self-play excluded from point estimate and interval alike)

win-rate-all-games.formula: wins / all eligible cross-policy games including draws and aborts

participant-prevalence.formula: unique participant-match pairs that selected entity ≥1 / all eligible participant-match records

match-prevalence.formula: unique matches in which entity selected ≥1 / all eligible matches

pick-rate-when-legal.uncertainty: Wilson 95% interval; N/A when zero legal opportunities
pick-rate-when-legal.denominator: decision frames in which the entity was legal

counter-efficiency.formula: opponent value prevented / own card and tempo cost

synergy-interaction.formula: exp(inverse-variance pooled log-odds A×B interaction over contributing policy|seat|profile strata); strata with an empty cohort, outcome separation or degenerate variance are excluded and disclosed; shrinkage log(OR)·n/(n+25) toward OR=1 with n = contributing observations; direction from sign(log OR)
synergy-interaction.uncertainty: Wald CI on log(OR) from pooled SE, exponentiated; BH FDR over modeled pairs; evidence graded on log(OR)
synergy-interaction.denominator: decisive participant-match records in contributing strata

immediate-point-impact.formula: sum actor-perspective secured point delta / resolved selections with point data

adjusted-win-association.formula: stratified win-rate differential controlling for policy, seat, profile
adjusted-win-association.denominator: decisive participant-match records in strata containing both cohorts

interpretationBoundary: Mechanics and synergy outputs are policy-, seat-, profile-, and telemetry-conditioned. They are evidence-backed associations, not automatic canon or balance changes. Win association is not causal proof. Synergy interaction is the A×B odds-ratio from a stratified logistic model.
recommendations: 143 mechanic(s) have sample size below 20 — interpret with caution.
